summary: Added scripts/release_notes.py: a pure render(merge_requests, tag) that returns Markdown (a heading with the tag, one '- !IID title (author)' bullet per merge request sorted by IID, a final count line) and a main(argv) that reads a JSON file given with --merge-requests and prints the notes. No network call; titles are kept verbatim. Not wired into the pipeline. Eight tests cover the empty list, ordering, Markdown characters, the CLI and its error path; red_check confirmed they fail on the old code.
next: Decide whether a release job should fetch the merged merge requests and call release_notes
